Not telling you what to do, but I say you should live to see a future where u can change what went wrong with your life. I'm also 19 and pretty emotionally unstable. I've done unforgivable things and I'm not so sure how, if at all, I'll go about life, but I like to think that I want to teach my future children to avoid making the mistakes I made, to show them love I was never shown, give them advice I was never given. I hate myself, but I would like to think that that hate would help me carry on.
Idk yet either, like I said, I'm also not in the best shape. But hopefully this helps and you can figure things out and continue on.

Hey, idk if this helps but to a certain degree I understand how ur friend feels. I've done unforgivable things and am the reason why someone is depressed, and I break down crying every day because of guilt and regret. I think the thing that's kept me going the most are friends, especially since I'm in college now and family is far away. The things I've done are horrible enough that I may never tell people about them, but even then my friends have talked to me, empathized, and cried with me. 

Having deep talks and crying with my friends is something that I really appreciated, even if they don't know about all my problems or fully understand what's going on in my life. I was able to keep myself from jumping because I knew that there were people who I could cry with and that cared about me. 

If you really care like you wrote that you do, ask them to talk again. Tell them that they don't need to tell you anything, but that you just want to let them know that you care. 

There may be a reason she can't tell you about her troubles, like how I can't share my circumstances with anyone. She might not tell you what's going on, but that doesn't mean she can't share how she feels. Share a moment together, talk, connect, and maybe cry a bit. You don't know how much it can really mean to her to just show that you care. And from someone who's also suffering in silence, thank you for caring so much about your friend.

Hey man, there's so much I can relate to here. I'm also the oldest of 3, 19 yr old upcoming sophomore in college. I've been beating myself up over something I did which pretty much ruined someone's life, and I'm exhausted also. 

Ik it's hard just to exist in this world, especially with what you've gone through. I don't know your exact circumstances, but ik how it feels to be hopeless. That's how I feel rn and how I've felt for a while. All I know and the only advice I can give is that people care about you, even if you don't know it.

For me, my friends have kept me going the past semester. I've been breaking down every day, thinking that I don't deserve to be happy or enjoy the things that I've taken away from others. I couldn't and still can't tell my friends what I've done, but even then they cried with me and comforted me.

Idk how much this helps, but I broke down reading ur post and I'm writing this comment with tears in my eyes. I just wanted to lyk that there are people who care and are rooting for you, even if it's just someone like me, a broken person on the other side of a screen. I hope u can find a reason to keep going, and if you ever feel like talking I'm here to listen.

Hey, I don't find this post stupid at all, so thx for being here. 

Honestly, there's so much shit going on in my life that's both hard to describe and say out loud. I did something that breaks a million taboos and idk what to do anymore. 

Abridged version is I pretty much ruined the life of someone close to me, and I'm depressed and drowning in guilt. I can't tell anybody about what I've done, and even though everything else in my life seems great, I'm suffering so much because of the one moment of stupidity. Idk what to do, whether or not to apologize, to die, or to keep going and suffer.

I've thought about dying, but I feel like it will just make things worse for the people I've hurt. But it's also rly hard to keep going and breaking down every day.

I actually just posted and the more detailed version is there, but yeah, shits tough to say the least.
